name: narration-video
category: 视频生成 / 财报解读
description: Turn financial reports and articles into narrated explainer videos: article → voiceover script (≥85% information retention) + outline → machine-generated source of truth → TTS → static storyboard checkpoint → chapter animation → deterministic A′ rendering to mp4 with subtitles and SRT. Two canvas profiles (Bilibili 16:9 / Xiaohongshu 3:4), 20+ machine gates and a 44-component controlled library.
